We hope that all of this will be of some aid in preparing your statement and apologise for not being able to furnish more specific information however as I'm sure you realize our area of concern is quite large and our resources very limited. Should you have any questions or if we can be of further aid please feel free to contact us.
Thanking you for your sincere interest in Dorchester and hoping that your efforts will result in an increased appreciation of our rich Historic Patrimony we remain:
Sincerely Milliam C Mill
William C. Wall
for:
DORCHESTER HISTORICAL SCOTETY
